hotKeys.zh-CN: 快捷键组合：任意个修饰键加一个普通键，取值参考 `KeyboardEvent.key`。组合不合法时抛错，更新后同样校验。
hotKeys.en-US: The key combination: any number of modifiers plus one other key, as `KeyboardEvent.key` values. An invalid combination throws, including after an update.

content.zh-CN: 显示的按键文字，缺省显示 hotKeys。
content.en-US: Key labels to show. Defaults to hotKeys.

preventDefault.zh-CN: 是否阻止快捷键的默认行为。
preventDefault.en-US: Whether the default behavior of the key combination is prevented.

onHotKey.zh-CN: 按下完整的快捷键组合时触发，参数为原生 `KeyboardEvent`。
onHotKey.en-US: Called when the full key combination is pressed, with the native `KeyboardEvent`.

render.zh-CN: 替换按键提示的渲染，可以是 JSX 元素或返回 JSX 元素的函数。传入 `null` 或返回 `null` 时不渲染任何元素，快捷键仍然有效。
render.en-US: Replaces the key hint. Accepts a JSX element or a function returning one. `null`, or a function returning `null`, renders nothing and the hot keys stay active.

getListenerTarget.zh-CN: 返回监听 keydown 的元素；缺省或返回 null、undefined 时使用 document.body。读取的信号变化时，监听目标随之切换。
getListenerTarget.en-US: Returns the element that listens for keydown. When omitted, or when it returns null or undefined, document.body is used. Signals read here move the listener when they change.
